headline: Trump’s AI testing plan is limited and vague
summary: Trump administration's AI cybersecurity framework reportedly excludes open models. Voluntary guidelines explicitly state they can't be used for inspecting open source AI. This makes the testing plan appear limited and vague, according to reports.

headline: Ted Lasso returns at an important time for Apple TV
summary: Apple TV+ has a strong lineup for 2026, featuring both returning favorites and new hit shows. The return of feel-good sports sitcom "Ted Lasso" is seen as a crucial release for the streaming service. Its comeback is poised to bolster Apple TV+'s impressive slate.

headline: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
summary: SpaceX is preparing to launch its own terrestrial mobile network. The company aims to directly compete with major US carriers like T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. Elon Musk and Gwynne Shotwell confirmed these ambitious plans during their first earnings call.

headline: Don’t screw this up, Marvel
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" quickly grossed $1 billion worldwide, setting a box office record. The film reaffirmed Sony's hold on Spider-Man rights and the success of its partnership with Marvel Studios. Marvel is now urged to carefully manage future adaptations following this triumph.

headline: James Cameron Considers Prioritizing 'Other Stories' as Avatar's Future Remains Uncertain
summary: Avatar director James Cameron has indicated he may be ready to move on from the franchise. The status of its two planned sequels still remains uncertain. Cameron expressed a desire to prioritize 'other stories' for the 'last act' of his career.

headline: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Season 1 Review
summary: "The Ninth Jedi" is praised as a terrific and excitingly unique take on the iconic Star Wars franchise. Despite some initial growing pains, the series delivers a fresh perspective. The review highlights its innovative approach within the Star Wars universe.

headline: Ted Lasso Season 4 Premiere Review
summary: Ted Lasso returns with an engaging Kansas City-set season premiere. The episode catches up with key characters after a three-year absence. It sets the stage for the show’s new soft reboot approach.

headline: X-Men '97 Season 2, Episode 8 Review & Recap: "Dead Man's Hand"
summary: X-Men '97 Season 2, Episode 8, titled "Dead Man's Hand," features a highly anticipated character return. Despite this, the episode left reviewers feeling cold. The review questions why the long-awaited moment didn't fully resonate.

headline: Police chief considers joining legal action over PC Harper killers' early release
summary: Two individuals convicted of killing PC Andrew Harper are set for early release under a government scheme. A police chief is considering legal action to challenge this decision. The early release, scheduled for October, has sparked considerable debate.

headline: Ex-MP urges Tories to block council candidate jailed for antisemitic abuse against her
summary: Joshua Bonehill-Paine, previously jailed for neo-Nazi activism, has been selected as a council candidate. An ex-MP is urging the Conservative party to block his candidacy for a 2027 Somerset Council seat. His selection has raised concerns due to his history of antisemitic abuse.

headline: Dewormer and scabies drugs being sold as cancer treatments, BBC investigation finds
summary: A BBC investigation has uncovered a scheme selling dewormer and scabies medications as fake cancer treatments. A terminally ill patient was offered these bogus drugs by a stair lift salesman. This highlights dangerous fraudulent practices targeting vulnerable individuals with false hope.

headline: Russian strike kills at least 17 as Zelensky says interceptors could have saved lives
summary: A Russian strike has resulted in the deaths of at least 17 people. Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that readily available interceptors could have saved these lives. Russia's defense ministry claimed it targeted logistics hubs and supply centers in the Kyiv region.
